paragraphs: Ireland has a rule about sending soldiers to other countries. It is called the "triple lock". If more than 12 Irish soldiers go abroad, three groups must agree. The Government, the Dáil and the United Nations (UN) must all say yes.
The Government wants to change this rule. It does not want to need the UN any more. It says some big countries can block Irish plans at the UN.
Willie O'Dea is a Fianna Fáil TD from Limerick. He wants a smaller change. Under his idea, a mission must still follow a UN vote. Nine other Fianna Fáil TDs support him.
Opposition parties say the plan is bad for Irish neutrality. More than 100 changes to the law have been suggested. The Government wants to pass the law before Christmas.

政府、眾議院和聯合國（UN）都必須點頭。
政府想要修改這條規定。
它不想再需要聯合國的同意。
政府說，一些大國可以在聯合國擋下愛爾蘭的計畫。

按照他的想法，任務仍須依循聯合國的一項表決。
另外九名共和黨議員支持他。
反對黨說，這個計畫對愛爾蘭的中立不利。
已有超過100項修法建議被提出。
政府希望在聖誕節前通過這項法律。

paragraphs: A group of Fianna Fáil TDs wants to change the Government's plan to reform the "triple lock". This is the rule that controls when Irish soldiers can be sent abroad.

At the moment, if more than 12 Irish troops go on a mission overseas, three things are needed. The Government must agree, the Dáil must vote for it, and the United Nations must give a mandate, or official permission. The Government wants to remove the UN part. It says that the five permanent members of the UN Security Council can block Irish missions, so they have too much power over Ireland.

Willie O'Dea, a Limerick TD and a former defence minister, has suggested a change to the Government's bill. Under his plan, a mission would need to be linked to a resolution of the UN General Assembly, where all countries have a vote. The minister would also have to say that the mission matches the aims of that resolution. However, each mission would not need its own UN permission.

Nine other Fianna Fáil TDs have signed his proposal. One of them, Michael Cahill from Kerry, said he wanted to show clearly that Ireland is still a neutral country. He said he was especially worried about young people under 30.
Opposition parties say the Government's bill weakens Irish neutrality. They fear soldiers could be sent on missions that are not about keeping the peace.

The Dáil's defence committee will now look at the bill. Its chair, Rose Conway-Walsh of Sinn Féin, said more than 100 changes have been suggested. She said the committee will take as long as it needs. The Government hopes to pass the law before the Dáil's Christmas break on 17 December.
sentZh: 一群共和黨眾議員想修改政府改革「三重鎖」的計畫。
這是一條控制愛爾蘭士兵何時可以被派往國外的規定。
目前，如果超過12名愛爾蘭軍人出國執行任務，需要具備三個條件。
政府必須同意、眾議院必須投票支持，而且聯合國必須給予授權，也就是正式許可。
政府想拿掉聯合國這一項。
政府說，聯合國安理會的五個常任理事國可以阻擋愛爾蘭的任務，因此它們對愛爾蘭有太大的權力。
利默里克眾議員、前國防部長威利·歐迪對政府的法案提出了一項修改。
按照他的計畫，任務需要與聯合國大會的一項決議相連結，而所有國家在聯合國大會都有投票權。
部長也必須說明任務符合該決議的目標。
不過，每項任務不需要各自取得聯合國的許可。
另外九名共和黨議員已簽署他的提案。
其中一位是來自凱里的麥可·卡希爾，他說他想清楚表明愛爾蘭仍是中立國家。
他說他特別擔心30歲以下的年輕人。
反對黨說政府的法案削弱了愛爾蘭的中立。
他們擔心士兵可能被派去執行與維持和平無關的任務。
眾議院國防委員會現在將審查這項法案。
委員會主席、新芬黨的蘿絲·康威－沃爾什說，已有超過100項修改建議被提出。

政府希望在12月17日眾議院聖誕休會前通過這項法律。

paragraphs: Fianna Fáil TDs are backing an amendment that would soften the Government's planned reform of the "triple lock", the system that governs overseas deployments of the Irish Defence Forces.

Under the current rules, sending more than 12 Irish troops abroad requires approval from the Government, a vote in the Dáil and a mandate from the United Nations. The Coalition wants to scrap the UN requirement, arguing that it effectively hands a veto over Irish troop movements to the five permanent members of the UN Security Council.

The amendment, tabled by Limerick TD and former defence minister Willie O'Dea at the Oireachtas defence committee, would require any deployment to be linked to a current resolution of the UN General Assembly. The minister would also have to confirm that the mission is consistent with the aims of that resolution, although a specific UN mandate for each mission would not be needed.

Nine of O'Dea's party colleagues have signed the proposal, including Cathal Crowe, John McGuinness and Pat "the Cope" Gallagher. Kerry TD Michael Cahill said he was keen to make it clear that Ireland remains neutral, adding that his main concern was reassuring voters under 30.

Opposition parties argue that the Government's bill dilutes Irish neutrality and could see troops sent on missions that go beyond traditional peacekeeping. They are expected to put pressure on the Fianna Fáil backbenchers involved.

Committee chair Rose Conway-Walsh of Sinn Féin said more than 100 amendments had been submitted and that the committee would examine the bill thoroughly, taking as long as necessary. The Government aims to have the legislation passed before the Dáil rises for Christmas on 17 December.
sentZh: 多名共和黨眾議員支持一項修正案，該修正案將軟化政府對「三重鎖」的改革計畫，這套制度規範愛爾蘭國防軍的海外部署。
根據現行規定，派遣超過12名愛爾蘭軍人出國，需要政府批准、眾議院投票以及聯合國授權。
聯合政府想廢除聯合國這項要求，理由是它實際上把愛爾蘭部隊調動的否決權交給了聯合國安理會五個常任理事國。
這項修正案由利默里克眾議員、前國防部長威利·歐迪向國會國防委員會提出，要求任何部署都須與聯合國大會一項現行決議相連結。
部長也必須確認任務與該決議的目標一致，不過每項任務不需要個別的聯合國授權。
歐迪的九名黨內同僚已簽署此提案，包括卡哈爾·克羅、約翰·麥吉尼斯和派特·「科普」·加拉格爾。
凱里眾議員麥可·卡希爾說，他很想明確表示愛爾蘭仍保持中立，並補充說他最關心的是讓30歲以下的選民安心。
反對黨認為政府的法案稀釋了愛爾蘭的中立，可能讓部隊被派去執行超出傳統維和範圍的任務。
預料他們會向參與其中的共和黨後座議員施壓。
委員會主席、新芬黨的蘿絲·康威－沃爾什說，已有超過100項修正案提交，委員會將徹底審查法案，需要多久就花多久。
政府的目標是在12月17日眾議院聖誕休會前讓這項立法通過。

paragraphs: A sizeable group of Fianna Fáil backbenchers has thrown its weight behind an amendment that would temper the Government's overhaul of the "triple lock", the long-standing safeguard governing the deployment of Irish troops overseas.

As things stand, any mission involving more than 12 members of the Defence Forces must secure the approval of the Cabinet, the endorsement of the Dáil and an explicit United Nations mandate. The Coalition intends to abolish the last of these conditions, contending that it grants the five permanent members of the Security Council a de facto veto over Irish foreign policy.

The amendment, lodged at the Oireachtas defence committee by Willie O'Dea, the Limerick TD and former defence minister, would oblige the Government to anchor any deployment in a current resolution of the UN General Assembly. The minister would further be required to certify that the mission accords with the objectives of that resolution, though a bespoke mandate for each operation would no longer be necessary.

Nine fellow party TDs have put their names to the proposal, among them veterans such as John McGuinness and Pat "the Cope" Gallagher. Michael Cahill, who represents Kerry, said he was anxious to underline that the State's neutrality remains intact, conceding that his foremost worry was winning over voters under the age of 30.

Opposition parties maintain that the legislation erodes neutrality and could pave the way for missions far removed from conventional peacekeeping. The TDs who have signed the amendment are likely to find themselves under sustained pressure from rival parties.

Rose Conway-Walsh, the Sinn Féin TD who chairs the committee, revealed that upwards of 100 amendments had been tabled, and pledged that scrutiny would be rigorous and unhurried. Nevertheless, the Government remains determined to enact the bill before the Dáil adjourns for Christmas on 17 December.
sentZh: 相當多的共和黨後座議員力挺一項修正案，該修正案將緩和政府對「三重鎖」的全面改革；這是長久以來規範愛爾蘭部隊海外部署的保障機制。
就目前而言，任何涉及超過12名國防軍成員的任務，都必須取得內閣批准、眾議院認可及聯合國的明確授權。
聯合政府打算廢除其中最後一項條件，主張它讓安理會五個常任理事國對愛爾蘭外交政策擁有事實上的否決權。
這項修正案由利默里克眾議員、前國防部長威利·歐迪向國會國防委員會提交，將要求政府把任何部署建立在聯合國大會一項現行決議之上。
部長還必須證明任務符合該決議的目標，不過每次行動不再需要量身訂做的授權。
九名同黨議員已在提案上署名，其中包括約翰·麥吉尼斯和派特·「科普」·加拉格爾等資深議員。
代表凱里的麥可·卡希爾說，他急於強調國家的中立完好無損，並承認他最擔心的是如何爭取30歲以下的選民。
反對黨堅稱這項立法侵蝕了中立，並可能為遠離傳統維和的任務鋪路。
簽署修正案的議員很可能會持續承受對手政黨的壓力。
擔任委員會主席的新芬黨眾議員蘿絲·康威－沃爾什透露，已有逾100項修正案提出，並承諾審查將嚴謹且不倉促。
儘管如此，政府仍決心在12月17日眾議院聖誕休會前完成立法。

paragraphs: A substantial cohort of Fianna Fáil backbenchers has endorsed an amendment that would moderate the Government's proposed reform of the "triple lock", the mechanism that has historically regulated the deployment of Irish troops abroad.

At present, overseas missions involving more than 12 personnel are contingent upon three distinct forms of approval: a Government decision, a Dáil vote and a United Nations mandate. The Coalition seeks to eliminate the third requirement, maintaining that it effectively confers a veto over Irish military commitments on the five permanent members of the Security Council.

The amendment, submitted by Willie O'Dea, a Limerick TD and former defence minister, would instead require that any deployment be linked to a current resolution of the UN General Assembly. Furthermore, the minister would be obliged to state explicitly that the mission is consistent with the objectives of that resolution. However, an individual UN mandate for each operation would not be required.

Nine additional Fianna Fáil TDs have formally supported the proposal. Michael Cahill, a Kerry TD, emphasised his desire to demonstrate that Irish neutrality remains intact, while acknowledging that his principal concern was persuading citizens under the age of 30.

Opposition parties contend that the legislation would significantly undermine neutrality and might facilitate missions extending well beyond traditional peacekeeping. It is therefore anticipated that the TDs concerned will face considerable political pressure.

The committee chair, Rose Conway-Walsh of Sinn Féin, indicated that in excess of 100 amendments had been submitted and stated that the committee would scrutinise the bill comprehensively, irrespective of the time required. Nevertheless, the Government's objective remains to enact the legislation before the Dáil's Christmas recess on 17 December.

目前，涉及超過12名人員的海外任務取決於三種不同的批准：政府決定、眾議院表決和聯合國授權。
聯合政府試圖取消第三項要求，主張它實際上賦予安理會五個常任理事國對愛爾蘭軍事承諾的否決權。
由利默里克眾議員、前國防部長威利·歐迪提交的修正案，則要求任何部署須與聯合國大會一項現行決議相連結。
此外，部長有義務明確聲明任務與該決議的目標一致。
不過，每項行動將不需要個別的聯合國授權。
另有九名共和黨眾議員正式支持這項提案。
凱里眾議員麥可·卡希爾強調，他希望證明愛爾蘭的中立完好無損，同時承認他主要擔心的是如何說服30歲以下的公民。
反對黨主張，這項立法將嚴重削弱中立，並可能促成遠遠超出傳統維和的任務。
因此預料相關議員將面臨相當大的政治壓力。
委員會主席、新芬黨的蘿絲·康威－沃爾什表示，已有超過100項修正案提交，並說委員會將全面審查法案，無論需要多少時間。
儘管如此，政府的目標仍是在12月17日眾議院聖誕休會前完成立法。
